prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Primary request: one original red paper-cut artwork for the Binzhou folk paper-cutting cultural topic. A complete airy rounded composition of two invented small birds among flowing stems, broad flowers and leaves, all made visually from a single red paper sheet with readable cut-out negative spaces. Do not copy Wang Derong's work or claim these are named traditional symbols.
Composition and medium: show the entire paper-cut silhouette with a wide margin of warm ivory paper around it, near face-on, slight natural edge lift and quiet shallow shadows. Controlled vermilion red, no gold border or multicolour collage, graceful flowing curves and a few strong simple interior cuts, tactile fine paper rather than plastic lace or laser-cut metal. One coherent craft-object portrait, no scissors, cutting hands, process steps, ruler, template numbers or festive lettering.
Authenticity: all decorative motifs and cut connections are invented; not an actual local artist's creation, historical pattern or guaranteed feasible cutting template. Do not label it an authentic specimen. No scenes of rituals or claims of a particular motif meaning.
One standalone horizontal 3:2 native artwork, ideally 1536x1024, not a UI, poster, map or contact sheet. Main object(s) fully visible with ample margins; not cropped at canvas edges. No real people, portraits, hands, readable text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, inscriptions, seals, signature, brand, logo or watermark. No existing artist's work, museum object, verified craft process or named product is copied.
